bias.en: Range · slipping toward $610, under all averages
bias.zh: 区间 · 逼近 $610，位于所有均线下方

read.en: Meta slipped 0.4% on Nov 18 to $616.38, trading $610.30–620.81 on light volume (0.44x the 20-day average). It is below the 10-day ($625.4), 5-day ($625.4), 200-day ($629.5, falling), 100-day ($639.0) and 30-day ($657.7, falling). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($603.76), and RSI is 41.4.
read.zh: Meta 11月18日下跌 0.4%，收于 $616.38，盘中区间 $610.30–620.81，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.44 倍）。股价位于 10 日（$625.4）、5 日（$625.4）、200 日（$629.5，下行）、100 日（$639.0）和 30 日均线（$657.7，下行）下方。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、趋近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$603.76），RSI 为 41.4。

read.en: The $610.30 low undercut the Nov 17 low ($613.51) intraday, but the close held above it; $618.9–620.8 capped the high. Resistance is $618.9–620.8, then $625.4–630 (5, 10 and 200-day, Nov 4 close) and $639–640.7 (100-day, Nov 16 high). Support is $610.2–610.3 (Nov 6 close, Nov 18 low), then $603.8–605.1 (SAR, Nov 5 close) and $583.8. A close above $620.8 would target $625–630; below $610.2, $604–605.
